source_text: Quis similis tibi in diis, Domine? Gloriosus in sanctis, mirabilis in majestatibus, faciens prodigia. Non comparatio idolorum aequalium, sed confessio incomparabilis.
pass_a_gloss: Who like to-you among gods, Lord? Glorious in holy-ones, wonderful in majesties, doing wonders. Not comparison of-idols equal, but confession incomparable.
pass_b_english: [[Who is like you among the gods, O Lord — glorious in the holy ones, doing wonders? >> Bible:Exodus 15:11]]. Not a ranking of peer idols, but the confession that none compares.
